description:
Design the complete architecture for the project-wiki scenario. This is inspired by Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki concept (https://gist.githubusercontent.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f/raw/ac46de1ad27f92b28ac95459c782c07f6b8c964a/llm-wiki.md) — where agents handle the maintenance burden that makes humans abandon knowledge bases, adapted for Vrooli's multi-team autonomous system. Read Karpathy's gist for foundational concepts (three-layer architecture, ingest/query/lint operations, index.md + log.md navigation).

This research must produce a detailed technical specification covering:

**Content Model:**
The wiki is organized as a directory of interlinked markdown files:
```
wiki/
├── index.md                     — Master catalog of all pages with summaries
├── log.md                       — Chronological record of all wiki operations
├── identity/                    — What Vrooli IS
│   ├── vision.md                — Core thesis, recursive improvement loop
│   ├── pitch.md                 — Investor/customer-facing deck content
│   ├── glossary.md              — Unified definitions (scenario, resource, etc.)
│   └── brand-voice.md           — How we communicate
├── strategy/                    — Where we're GOING
│   ├── roadmap.md               — Living roadmap with phase status
│   ├── priorities.md            — Current Now/Near/Far from director-swarm
│   ├── initiatives/             — One page per active initiative
│   └── decisions.md             — Major strategic decisions with rationale
├── capabilities/                — What we CAN DO
│   ├── scenarios/               — One page per scenario (business context, not code docs)
│   ├── resources/               — Resource catalog with integration info
│   └── deployment.md            — What's deployed, where, tier status
├── operations/                  — How we WORK
│   ├── teams.md                 — Team registry, missions, status
│   ├── architecture.md          — Platform architecture overview
│   ├── patterns.md              — Proven patterns and anti-patterns
│   └── lessons-learned.md       — Post-incident/post-project insights
├── revenue/                     — How we EARN
│   ├── model.md                 — Revenue model and funnels
│   ├── opportunities/           — Evaluated opportunities
│   └── metrics.md               — Revenue milestones
├── marketing/                   — How we COMMUNICATE
│   ├── campaigns/               — Campaign records
│   ├── audience.md              — Audience insights
│   └── content-calendar.md      — What's planned/published
└── quality/                     — How HEALTHY we are
    ├── platform-health.md       — Agent success rates, velocity
    ├── scenario-quality/        — QA audit summaries per scenario
    └── tech-debt.md             — Known debt, refactoring priorities
```

Pages are organized by question ("What can we do?" → capabilities/), not by team. Multiple teams feed the same sections. Scenario wiki pages capture business context and revenue potential, not code-level documentation (Knowledge Observatory already handles code docs).

**Three Core Operations** (adapted from Karpathy):
- **Ingest:** Read new signal (swarm-manager completion, team handoff, repo change), determine affected wiki pages, update/create pages, maintain cross-links, update index.md, append to log.md
- **Query:** Find answers across wiki content. Simple queries served directly from markdown. Complex/semantic queries delegated to Knowledge Observatory
- **Lint:** Periodic health checks — find contradictions between pages, stale content, orphaned pages, missing cross-references, sections with no content

**API Design:**
- CRUD endpoints for wiki pages
- Search endpoint (delegates to KO for semantic, does local text search for simple)
- Ingest endpoint (accepts a signal payload, determines affected pages, returns proposed updates)
- Lint endpoint (runs health check, returns issues)
- Log/history endpoint

**CLI Design:**
- project-wiki read <path>
- project-wiki search <query>
- project-wiki ingest --source <swarm-manager|team-handoff|manual> --data <payload>
- project-wiki lint
- project-wiki log [--last N]
- project-wiki publish (sync to Knowledge Observatory)

**Signal Stream Integration Design:**
- How the wiki maintenance agent reads Swarm Manager completions (CLI commands, fields to extract, page routing)
- How it reads team heartbeat outputs — handoffs from teams/{id}/shared/handoff-history.jsonl, decisions from decisions.jsonl, knowledge from knowledge.jsonl
- How it uses each team's contributions declarations from team.json v2 to route signals to wiki sections
- Filtering heuristics: research items completing → always wiki-worthy. Minor chore completing → usually not. Strategic shift in handoff → wiki-worthy. Routine retry note → not.

**Knowledge Observatory Integration:**
- Wiki pages published to KO as a dedicated namespace
- KO provides semantic search over wiki content via existing embedding pipeline (Ollama nomic-embed-text → Qdrant 768-dim)
- Define namespace convention and metadata schema for wiki records in KO
name: project-wiki-architecture
title: Design Project Wiki Scenario Architecture And Content Model
